concerns: The open ask to Sami overstates the tap cost: secretsd scopes a tokenless grant to (terminal, secretsd run), so a daemon restart in the same launcher pane within 12 h costs zero taps; sent to the architect via envoy_publish e446faa655c93608b163059989dea5dc.

secretsd identifies a tokenless caller by isatty(stdin) + /proc/self/fd/0: the daemon's `secrets` children must inherit stdin (stdio inherit) and the daemon must be started with stdin on the launcher pane's terminal; the runbook carries the launcher half.

Planner decision beyond the spec text: the `secrets` children also drop SECRETSD_SESSION_TOKEN_FILE so the grant is always the launcher pane's, never an agent session's. stripDispatchEnv is unchanged.
The launcher pane must be a terminal no agent session has used since secretsd last started (learned agent ttys refuse tokenless requests).

Acceptance 1's `secrets <KEY> -- true` from a worker pane blinks Sami's YubiKey and times out after 90 s rather than refusing silently; a quieter equivalent is `secrets get <KEY> --no-request` showing grant:false. Architect's call which the tester runs.
